meta.reconciliation_note: RECONCILED 2026-11-26: The 18 Nov 2025 ceremony article lists 72 star entries (5 + 15 + 52), while MICHELIN's live New York City filtered lists hold 69 (5 + 14 + 50). Next ceremony: 14 Dec 2026.
